$description: FunnelChart (platform/charts/FunnelChart.jsx; library wave 9, lane C): its component tokens. The bars are the chart frame's marks (data-viz color); everything else is an existing role.

funnel-stage-width.$description: Funnel chart, vertical: the room before the plot for the stage names (the frame's start margin).

funnel-label-room.$description: Funnel chart, vertical: the room after the plot for the count and share at the end of the longest bar.

funnel-label-room-block.$description: Funnel chart, horizontal: the room above the plot for the label over the tallest column.

funnel-drop-background.$description: Funnel chart: the stage before's length behind a bar, so the drop between stages shows.

funnel-name-room-block.$description: Funnel chart, horizontal: the room under the plot for the stage names, in one or two lines.

funnel-edge.$description: Funnel chart: the room on the sides without names or labels (the bars carry their values, so there is no value axis).
